summary: GET /api/v1/agents stops calling the Envoy listener's GET /v1/sessions per request and reads the Dispatch process's rosterCache (api/issue_route_status.go), the 5 s copy every issue read already uses for route_status. The roster keeps the decoded []envoy.Session and the fetch error; listAgents copies the slice before sorting and still answers 503 ENVOY_UNAVAILABLE on failure. A test-only DISPATCH_TEST_ROSTER_UNCACHED=1 (under DISPATCH_TEST_HOOKS=1) keeps the Playwright suite's fake listener read per request.

decisionsSettled.answer: Accepted: a listener slower than 2 s (routeRosterTimeout) answers 503 where today the client waits 5 s; after a failed fetch, agents reads within routeRosterSilenceTTL (5 s) answer the same 503 without a new call. Both still 503 ENVOY_UNAVAILABLE with the fetch's error. Record both in the pull request body.
